name: web-solid-midnight-indigo-strip-background
title: Solid Midnight Indigo Strip
whatItIs: A very wide, very short flat strip in a single deep midnight indigo, with no visible content or gradient.
whatItMeans: A dark saturated flat tone serves as a quiet base color: professional, night-like and versatile behind light text.
techniques: Use one deep, slightly purple-tinted navy instead of pure black
Let a flat band act as a section divider or footer base
Keep it uncluttered so overlaid white or neon text pops
Treat colour alone as the design
bestFor: Colour reference for tech and finance palettes

vocabulary.definition: A uniform fill without gradient or texture.
A thin coloured strip separating page sections.
A very dark colour with a hint of hue, warmer or cooler than pure black.
